slice: PR 2 of 3: the touch context group. Every context control (cylinders, gas information, fast-forward, torch, setpoint -/+, bailout, help, mute) is pressed by click (mouse, keyboard, a lone tap) and by any finger lifted over it (src/app/touch-press.ts), so a second finger works it while a thumb holds the D-pad, as legacy's touchstart binding does; the groups are named; the torch names T; press feedback on the dock and topbar
workingTree: the runs below ran on the working tree committed as this PR's first commit; dist/ was built from it with `npx vite build` after `npm run typecheck`, with vite 8.3.2 installed (main has since bumped it to 8.3.5 in #263, a dependency-only change)

environment.load: machine shared with other agents' Playwright and Vitest runs; one Playwright worker on a private port (8391)

e2eRelated.command: npx playwright test tests/touch-context.spec.js tests/touch-dpad.spec.js tests/in-dive-controls.spec.js tests/hud-readouts.spec.js tests/help-overlay.spec.js tests/onboarding-hints.spec.js tests/wreck-slice.spec.js --workers=1
e2eRelated.note: after it, touchstart's listener was marked passive (it never calls preventDefault); on that final tree tests/touch-context.spec.js and tests/touch-dpad.spec.js passed 23 of 23, and the touch and button cases of in-dive-controls, help-overlay and onboarding-hints (-g "touch|button") 15 of 15

counterChecks.change: src/app/wreck-app.ts as on main (presses by click alone), with this PR's spec
counterChecks.result: the four 'a second finger, with a thumb on the D-pad' cases fail: torch, cylinder and gas information; fast-forward; setpoint and bailout; help

counterChecks.change: the touchend's preventDefault() removed from src/app/touch-press.ts
counterChecks.result: 'a tap presses once; a touch slid off or cancelled presses nothing' fails: the setpoint reads 0.90 bar after one tap (the touch and the lone tap's click both pressed)

measurements.secondFingerOnMain: Chromium, 390x844, thumb on the D-pad's left, second finger on the torch: pointerdown (isPrimary false), touchstart, pointerup, touchend, no click; the torch stayed on
measurements.geometry: at 390x844 and 360x640 (phone) and 1280x720 (desktop), technical with six cylinders (11 context controls) and rebreather (8), each at a safety stop: every context control on screen, at least 44x44, and at least 8 px from every other control of the dive screen; no exception
